thesis: A narrow intermediate trend threshold can preserve the positive cost-stressed breakout edge while increasing the historical trade sample above the promotion minimum.
rationale: The prior dense search found a 76-trade, positive cost-stressed strategy near EMA 0.0005, RSI 45, no volume floor, 90-minute holding, limit entry, 50-bps stop and target. This search bridges nearby frequency and selectivity values without changing risk gates.
